data.standardized_narrative: At the 2017 year end the syndicate's prior-year gross claims reserves showed no material movement (the claims development triangle indicates effectively no prior-year development). The large increase in total gross outstanding claims compared with opening balances principally reflects current year (2017) incurred claims and the growth of the 2017 underwriting year, and the 2016 and 2017 portfolios were materially impacted by a number of natural catastrophe events (HIMM: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexican earthquake) which affected marine, cargo and property lines. Overall there is no aggregate gross prior-year strengthening or release identified in the gross triangle for underwriting years 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: Falling oil prices led to a fall in premium income written in Lloyd's which in turn meant that growth prospects in energy and liability were effectively stopped.

The hull account ran at a net loss ratio of 149% and sustained a net underwriting loss of GBP 7m. These losses were caused by a combination of a large loss of GBP 1.6m and a higher than expected incidence of attritional claims.

The property account ran at a net loss ratio of 117% and sustained a net underwriting loss of GBP 0.5m. Contributing to this loss were two catastrophe losses which impacted the portfolio disproportionately.
GBP 3.1m impact from HIMM in relation to policies which incepted in 2016 and were in force at the time of these events.
The net impact of HIMM is GBP 12.5m.
The cargo account is running at a gross loss ratio of 224% (net 187%) and sustained an underwriting loss of GBP 7.1m.
Attritional loss ratio was 82%, improving slightly to 81% in 2016 and currently performing at 57% in 2017.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not explicitly stated as a gross figure in narrative notes. PYD was derived from the gross claims development triangle (found in the technical reserves note) which indicates effectively no movement for underwriting years 2015. The report contains significant catastrophe commentary (HIMM) which relates to 2016/2017 exposures; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided in a separate 'movement in prior year provision' line. Confidence in PYD is 0.8 because it is calculated from the printed gross triangle.
